Subject: Re: (User unknown in virtual alias table} on cleanup

On Wed, Feb 13, 2008 at 04:13:06PM -0700, Paul Dulaba wrote:

> Thanks! I have this working now using a combination of
> virtual_alias_maps/domains, an empty relay_recipient_maps, specific
> relay_domains and no "mydestination" setting. I have a fatal error in the
> log now, but I will start a new topic for that one.
> 

Note, an empty "relay_recipient_maps" is different from a setting
that uses an empty table. I was suggesting:

    main.cf:
	relay_recipient_maps = hash:/etc/postfix/relay_rcpts

    relay_rcpts: (empty file)

provided that *all* relay recipients are listed in virtual_alias_maps.
Do not disable relay recipient validation.

-- 
	Viktor.
